title: Anyone burns a victim's per-signer relay budget by replaying the victim's already-used create/accept authorization
One-source football questions: every foreign proposal is "unconfirmed", last-call disputes drain the bond float to an attacker, then a wrong proposal is only paged
OUTCOME settle pass has no wait back-off: 500 rows on a non-final question hide every later OUTCOME row
Release user to root and signature-gate bypass: root runs verify-commit in the release user's clone with safe.directory=* and honours its gpg.ssh.program
Anyone with an intent UUID (visible in group chats) rewrites its escrowId/sender and can bind the owner's notifications to another address
R3-L1 residual: build/escrow/mine/question,/q,/readyz have no read budget; /stats/users caches per since value
verifyBuildAnswer checks only internal consistency, not amount/recipient/referee vs what the user asked; a referee field overrides the typed referee shown in the preview
Waits and failures share one back-off counter: one failed send after a market-closed hold parks the row 6 h
The release user can make root read any file and publish it as a public GitHub Release body
Created-row state read at latest block, not the log's block; a lagging RPC node could store zeros that are never corrected
A rescheduled fixture may resolve instead of VOID (provider behaviour unverified)
Resolver tick has no time budget; disputes go out only after every source read
Decision typehash does not name the signer (bound only through per-signer nonce and isValid); no ERC-6492 for undeployed smart accounts
PostDeployCheck reads expectations from the JSON the deploy wrote, no bytecode compare, no handed-over mode; real-chain deploy JSON lacks tx hashes
Server-signed cherry-picks/reverts fail the owner-only allowed_signers gate, so rollbacks PAUSE (fail-safe)
bun audit: 9 high (hono 4.8.4, drizzle 0.44.2, @trpc/server 11.4.3, zod via viem); none reachable (no JWT/serveStatic/sql.identifier, middleware on *); bump anyway
M-4 fix residual: rgit honours a .git/info/grafts file the release user plants, so the descendant and on-main checks can be forged and an older owner-signed revision deployed (downgrade)
M-3 residual: ~30k paid earlier-expiring escrows kept un-backed-off could delay (not starve) an OUTCOME settle; anyone can settle
FeeRouter.sweep has no owner check, so anyone paying gas can make the admin monitor post a Swept alert; funds only move to fixed recipients

Gamma list endpoint /markets?slug= omits CLOSED markets: every resolved Polymarket question read pending forever, OUTCOME payments only refunded at expiry (missed by earlier runs; stubs answered any URL); fixed by /markets/slug/<slug>, checked live

The Odds API scores daysFrom<=3: a finished game read more than 3 days after kickoff is missing -> pending, never final; a resolver outage >3 d turns a met football payment into a refund (and a correct foreign proposal into a last-call dispute)
RESOLVER_CREATOR now must be the relayer key; nothing asserts the deployed creator equals the api's relayer address (fails closed: OUTCOME builds get NotCreator)
Outflow cursor advances even when a Telegram send failed, so that large-release alert is lost (window alert still fires)
Comment says feeFor changes only by a timelocked call; setFees is instant (cache feeds previews only; build reads fresh; a stale-fee signature fails closed)

Origin accepts any Cloudflare IP: a request routed through the attacker's own Cloudflare zone/Worker can choose cf-ipcountry (courtesy geo gate only; testnet co-host template); close with authenticated origin pulls
Nonce guard reads the operator-declared DEPLOYER, not the --account that signs; DRYRUN_COMMIT is self-declared: both guards are advisory
